prs.title: fix: strip trailing slashes from OAuth metadata URL fields
prs.author: maxisbey
prs.cluster_pick_reason: Both PRs have unknown CI status. Neither is noted as including tests. #1938 touches 4 files vs #2019's 5 files, making it the smaller, more focused diff. #1938 is also the older PR. Its title ("strip trailing slashes from OAuth metadata URL fields") suggests it addresses the fix across multiple URL fields rather than only the issuer URL, which is a more complete fix for the same root cause. On all tiebreakers where data is available — smaller diff and older — #1938 wins.

prs.title: Fix issue where client tool call hangs forever if server crashes or connection dies when using streamable-http
prs.author: gyang-xai
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Client tool calls hang forever when the server or connection fails in streamable-http. Both PRs fix missing error propagation to pending waiters — #1578 covers the POST path (HTTP connection dies), #2122 covers the SSE stream path (stream errors not forwarded to callers). (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Client tool calls hang forever when the server or connection fails in streamable-http. Both PRs fix missing error propagation to pending waiters — #1578 covers the POST path (HTTP connection dies), #2122 covers the SSE stream path (stream errors not forwarded to callers). (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: #1578 introduces the concrete `_send_error_response` helper — an explicit, reusable mechanism for routing transport-layer errors back to waiting callers on the POST path. #2122's visible changes are a logging addition in session.py and a reconnection-count bump; its SSE error-propagation logic (the substantive fix) should be contributed into #1578 so a single PR covers both failure paths. #1578's approach is more architecturally direct.

prs.title: fix: remove shell=True from subprocess calls in mcp dev
prs.author: Br1an67
prs.cluster_pick_reason: CI status is unknown for both PRs. Neither is confirmed to include tests. Falling through to diff size and age: #2190 changes 1 file vs #2351's 2 files, making it the smaller, more focused fix. #2190 also predates #2351 by PR number. The single-file change is sufficient to remove shell=True from the affected subprocess calls, and the extra file in #2351 is unconfirmed as a test rather than an unrelated change.

prs.title: fix: validate_scope treats None registered scopes as no restrictions
prs.author: shivama205
prs.cluster_pick_reason: Both PRs have unknown CI. #2224 is the older PR with a 2-file diff that makes a targeted fix inside validate_scope — treating None registered_scopes as "no restrictions" — preserving the existing validation structure while fixing the specific edge case. #2301 takes a broader approach (5 files) by removing the scope registration check from the authorize handler entirely, which is a larger structural change with more surface area for unintended side effects. clusters.pick_reason: #1578 introduces the concrete `_send_error_response` helper — an explicit, reusable mechanism for routing transport-layer errors back to waiting callers on the POST path. #2122's visible changes are a logging addition in session.py and a reconnection-count bump; its SSE error-propagation logic (the substantive fix) should be contributed into #1578 so a single PR covers both failure paths. #1578's approach is more architecturally direct.
